A1.justification: Both PDFs describe VistaWise and contain readable main text, equations, figures, tables, and Appendices A-F. The complete material supports reliable comparison despite citation and layout changes.

before.justification: v1 reports original Minecraft task trials, component ablations, retrieval measurements, and token-consumption results in Tables 1-4 and Figures 4-5.

after.justification: v3 retains the original VistaWise task results, ablations, retrieval measurements, and inference-cost analysis.

M1.justification: Section 3 retains the same object detector, cross-modal knowledge graph, path-searching followed by entity-matching pooling, desktop skill library, memory stack, and LLM action procedure. The appendix skill functions and prompt template also match.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same Minecraft dataset of 471 frames, 3,304 annotations, and 23 entity types, and evaluate the same diamond-acquisition task and milestones. No additional domain or test scenario appears.

E2.justification: Table 1 retains STEVE-1, GROOT, DEPS, Omni JARVIS, JARVIS-1, VPT, and ROCKET-1. The retrieval comparators, alternative LLM policies, and Voyager inference-cost comparison are also unchanged.

E3.justification: Section 4.1 retains the 9:1 training/testing split, YOLOv10-L, 150 epochs, batch size 16, image size 768, and GPT-4o policy. The Minecraft configuration, milestone evaluation, and retrieval metrics also match.

E4.justification: Tables 2-4 and Figures 4-5 retain the same analyses of entity attributes, retrieval strategies and pooling order, LLM visual perception, memory, CoT, KG, and token consumption. No ablation or supplementary analysis is added or removed.

E5.justification: Both versions specify 15 repeated trials by default and report three-attempt counts in Tables 3-4. Neither adds seed information, confidence intervals, significance tests, or other uncertainty reporting.

E6.justification: The numerical entries and findings match across the tables and plots. For example, Table 1 retains diamond success rates of 0.33 for VistaWise and 0.25 for ROCKET-1, while Figure 5 retains token totals of 324456, 430814, and 468756.

T1.justification: The definitions of observations, visual attributes, graph pooling, and agent workflow, including Equations (1)-(6), are unchanged. Neither version contains additional theorems or proofs.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction contributions, and conclusion retain the same claims about reduced training-data requirements, cross-modal knowledge integration, desktop control, cost efficiency, and task performance. The claim of 33% diamond success versus the previous 25% remains unchanged.

C2.justification: Both versions give the same explanations for the ablation findings, including resource randomness and the importance of pooling order. The limitation concerning LLM latency and increased task-completion time when pausing the environment is retained.

D1.justification: The dataset access link, hardware, detector settings, empirical thresholds, and software environment remain unchanged. Appendices B-F retain the same annotation counts, game settings, skill-generation process, KG-construction details, and prompt template.

R1.justification: The bibliography expands from 65 to 78 works, including TokenSwap, ACL/SFIR image restoration, and VLM attack/defense studies. These additions mainly supplement existing citation clusters without substantively revising the discussion of Minecraft agents, knowledge graphs, or VistaWise's novelty.

P1.justification: Author-year citations become numerical citations, with corresponding bibliography formatting and ordering changes. The Queensland affiliation drops 'The'; the substantive prose, section sequence, and appendix text remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Text reflow relocates existing displays: Table 2 moves from the right to the left column of page 7, and appendix tables shift across columns and pages. The figures, table structures, icons, axes, legends, and displayed content are retained.

improvement.justification: v3 preserves the same method, experimental evidence, reproducibility information, and limitations, including the complete appendix content. The added references and citation/layout revisions provide no substantive new synthesis and do not materially strengthen or weaken the paper's scientific support or clarity.
